name: Alexander Shulgin
bio: American chemist and psychopharmacologist whose work ranged from industrial chemistry to psychoactive phenethylamines, tryptamines, and ethnobotanical pharmacology.

name: Claudio Naranjo
bio: Chilean psychiatrist, psychotherapist, and writer whose early work joined medical anthropology, psychedelic research, and experimental psychotherapy.

name: Garcia de Orta
bio: Portuguese physician and naturalist in Goa whose 1563 Colloquies recorded South Asian materia medica through direct observation and dialogue.

name: Gerardo Reichel-Dolmatoff
bio: Austrian-born Colombian anthropologist and archaeologist known for fieldwork among Indigenous peoples in Colombia, including influential writing on Tukano cosmology and yaje.

name: J. G. Soares Maia
bio: Brazilian natural-products chemist associated with INPA and Amazonian phytochemistry, including chemical study of Virola theiodora.

name: William Antônio Rodrigues
bio: Brazilian botanist associated with INPA, known for taxonomic work on Amazonian plants including Virola.
